theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_fv_perturbation_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → HasCompactSupport Z → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < c → Injective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ ∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)
